prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create an exceptionally polished high-fidelity desktop application screen for RainyDays, a general AI desktop assistant for Chinese-speaking people who work with files, research, and Word/Excel documents. This is a functional application design, NOT a landing page, not a photo, no browser/device frame, no perspective. 1536x1024 landscape screen. Design direction explicitly chosen by user: quiet Claude Code / Claude desktop feel, conversational and text-first. Warm neutral porcelain background #F6F5F1, slightly darker sidebar #EEEDE8, near-black #2B2A27 text, subdued grey secondary text, restrained muted terracotta #B56649 accent. Clear crisp Chinese sans-serif UI typography, natural readable font sizes, generous but purposeful spacing, sophisticated alignment, understated 1px borders only where useful, modest rounded 10-14px input and message shapes. Assistant answers are unboxed flowing text; user request is a soft warm-grey compact bubble. Uniform delicate outline icons, no emoji, no purple, no glowing edges, no gradients, no decorative photography, no dashboard metrics. Real product title RainyDays with original simple four-stroke rain mark, not Claude logo. Show a working conversation with illustrative data, not an empty welcome screen. Exact main conversation title: “整理本周的研究资料”. User message: “帮我整理这份资料，生成一份简洁的研究报告和数据表。” attached file pill “研究资料.pdf”. Assistant body: “资料已整理，报告和数据表已生成。” followed by short readable lines about “核心结论”, “保留来源与关键数据”, “你可以打开检查，或继续提出修改要求。” Collapsed tool activity line: “已读取资料 · 已生成 2 份文件” with a small check icon. Artifacts named “研究报告.docx” and “研究数据.xlsx”, subtle file-type labels DOCX / XLSX, buttons “打开” and “继续修改”. Bottom composer placeholder “描述你想完成的事，或添加文件…” with attachment plus on left and terracotta square send-arrow button on right, small helper text “Enter 发送 · Shift + Enter 换行”. Calm model indicator “通用助手” and small “就绪”. All glyphs sharp and legible. Small unobtrusive footer “设计预览 · 演示数据”. No marketing slogans or fictional capabilities. Composition B — conversation with on-demand document inspection. Full-height 208px left sidebar with RainyDays, new conversation, search, recent sessions, settings as in a premium desktop assistant. Main working area splits into 650px conversation center and 440px open right document preview. The preview is an explicitly user-opened view, header “研究报告.docx”, close X and “继续修改” small button. Preview has warm-white document body, title “研究报告”, small subtitle “基于上传资料整理”, headings “01 核心结论” and “02 关键数据”, a few realistic Chinese paragraph lines, and small simple 3-row table. Document has normal semantic typography not a photo. Center conversation flows naturally with smaller artifact rows, bottom composer fits center. Top page header carries title and a selected “成果 2” toggle. Fine vertical separator, no boxing every section. Express polished information density, clearly different composition from single-column chat, yet same quiet warm neutral visual identity.
